pausedSub: Cofa okanye cinezela u-Enter ukuze uqhubeke.
emptySub: Yongeza umxholo kulo mdlalo ukuze ukwazi ukuwudlala.
copyFail: Umbhalo ukhethiwe. Wukope nge-Ctrl okanye Cmd + C.
stageLabel: Umdlalo wehlabathi elivulekileyo. Hambisa umlinganiswa ujikeleze. Imibono iza kukuvavanya ngemibuzo.
stageHow: Hamba ngokusebenzisa amaqhosha omnxeba okanye W A S D. Cinezela u-N ukuya endlini elandelayo. Xa umbono uvela, cinezela u-1 ukuya ku-4 okanye u-Tab no-Enter ukuphendula. Cinezela u-Tab ukuqhubeka. Umbhalo opheleleyo ukwakhona phantsi kwesithi Funda ungadlali.
hintKeys: Amaqhosha omnxeba okanye WASD ukuhamba. N endlini elandelayo.
guideText: Zulazula. Imibono iza kukufumana, okanye betha emnyango wendlu etshixiweyo ukuhlangana nomnye.
knockedOut: Iwisile! Ibuyele umva. Iintliziyo zakho ziphindiwe, ngoko zama kwakhona.
knockedDialog: I-{name} ibalekile. Betha emnyango wendlu yayo ukuze uyijongane kwakhona.
